svg.text: * IHP IO library (DCNDiode, DCPDiode); on the sourcepath of the PDK .spiceinit
* ---- supplies: iovdd = ring 3.3 V (front end, bias, output stage), vcore = 1.2 V core ring
* ---- slot-side controls (1.2 V logic) and the slot supplies seen by the presence detectors
* ---- harness iDAC: a sourced current from a PMOS mirror on its own 3.3 V supply
XEd xg xg vext vext sg13_hv_pmos w=5u l=6u
XEm ibias xg vext vext sg13_hv_pmos w=5u l=6u
* ---- differential input around vicm: vinp - vinn = v(dp)
.options savecurrents klu method=gear reltol=1e-4 abstol=1e-15 gmin=1e-15 SEED=CACE[CACE{seed=12345} + CACE{iterations=0}]
meas ac Acl find adb at=1k
meas ac f3db when adn=-3 fall=1
meas ac PSRR_1k find psr at=1k
meas ac PSRR_100k find psr at=100k
meas ac Acm find cmdb at=1k
meas ac Zout_1k find zo at=1k
meas ac Zout_1M find zo at=1meg
CACE template: closed-loop gain, PSRR from iovdd, CMRR, output impedance
sg13cmos5l_IOPadDiff2Single. Sources, load and analysis are in the code blocks; the DUT pins carry net labels.
xc (en_ctrl_3v3) and xg (bias_gen_pd): outside the pad cell since 2026-11-03 (backannotation to the drawn cell),
wired as in the former pad sheet; the sources that drove the old pad pins now drive them.
